lines.text: Jake starts down a steep, loose descent and leans on his pole.
It slides shorter and he stumbles.
Before you head down, do the five-second pole check.
Set the length, close every lock all the way,
then press your full weight into the pole on flat ground.
If it moves, tighten it and test again.
Now Jake heads down on a pole that holds, and rechecks it at every break.
Save this before your next descent.
